question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Black sheep
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"black sheep"** refers to a person who is considered a disgrace or failure by their family or group. (बदनाम व्यक्ति)

 
 
• **Example:** He was the** black sheep** of the family, always getting into trouble and causing embarrassment.
 
 
 
• **Disreputable** means not considered to be respectable in character or appearance. (बदनाम)
 
 
• **Example:** The **disreputable** man was often seen loitering around shady parts of the town.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is:** Disreputable.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Naive** (भोला): Showing a lack of experience, wisdom, or judgment.

 
 
• **Example:** She was too **naive** to realize the risks involved in the investment.
 
 
 
• **Miscreant** (दुष्ट): A person who behaves badly or in a way that breaks the law.
 
 
• **Example:** The **miscreant** was arrested for vandalizing public property.
 
 
 
• **Intelligent** (बुद्धिमान): Having or showing intelligence, especially of a high level.
 
 
• **Example:** She is an **intelligent **student who always tops her class.
